vehicle.name: 1990 Lexus LS 400 (UCF10)
vehicle.origin: front axle centre projected to the ground plane
vehicle.configuration: Target: December 1989 U.S. UCF10L-AEPGKA, CA emissions, air suspension, original R12 context; VIN and retrofit state remain unverified

checks.name: Component IDs are unique
checks.detail: 65 stable IDs checked.

checks.name: Important components have geometry
checks.detail: 40 important components built.

checks.name: Every modeled line has two valid endpoints
checks.detail: 16 routes have named start and destination objects.

checks.name: A/C fittings align with their route endpoints
checks.detail: 7 A/C routes align to both named endpoints; the 200 mm staging tolerance reflects approximate geometry.

checks.name: Important A/C components are mounted
checks.detail: Compressor, condenser, receiver, ports and cabin components have named mounts.

checks.name: Important objects are not generic placeholders
checks.detail: No important object is marked generic_placeholder; approximate true-form geometry remains labeled.

checks.name: Service ports are attached to the correct pressure-side groups
checks.detail: High port is bound to the liquid line; low port is bound to the suction line. Exact installed positions remain warnings.

checks.name: Front view preserves passenger/driver and vertical orientation
checks.detail: Facing the open hood, passenger side projects to screen-left, driver side to screen-right, and +Z remains upward.

checks.name: Pressure and service branches are anchored
checks.detail: Pressure switch, high port and low port are selectable features anchored to their parent line groups.

checks.name: High/low flow sequence uses the correct ports
checks.detail: Compressor to condenser to receiver to expansion valve to evaporator to EPR to compressor is continuous.

checks.name: No duplicate A/C components share the same pose
checks.detail: No important A/C component rendered bounding-box centres are duplicated.

checks.name: Key A/C components avoid unrelated geometry
checks.detail: No broad-phase overlap across the key unrelated-component pairs.

checks.name: Every route has continuous visible geometry
checks.detail: All route groups contain selectable line geometry, fittings, and applicable clamps/crimps.

checks.name: Service-planning overlay is safety-gated
checks.detail: Refrigerant profile, recovery and zero-pressure gates control a boundary-only overlay; normal-flow arrows are labeled as non-authorization.

checks.name: Reference images resolve to labeled camera poses and rights notes
checks.detail: 8 references have a local path, saved pose and reuse-rights note.

checks.name: EWD070U electrical source is acquired
checks.detail: The 250-page EWD is present locally; physical loom geometry and circuit extraction remain incomplete.

checks.name: Exact service-port landing is unresolved
checks.detail: High and low side identities are modeled correctly, but original/retrofit fitting position must be verified on the target vehicle.

checks.name: Installed pipe centerlines remain provisional
checks.detail: The early EPC establishes liquid A/B/C/D/E and suction B/C/E families; installed centerlines and fitting clocking still require physical measurement.

checks.name: Configuration and dimensional survey are missing
checks.detail: VIN/build month, refrigerant/oil state, TRAC/options, measured line splines, clamps and fitting clocking remain capture inputs.

checks.name: Private reference images are not cleared for publication
checks.detail: 7 of 8 comparison images are private/no-ship research references; only the public-domain exterior image is cleared for redistribution.

unresolvedRouting: target-vehicle electrical harness branches, clips and connector poses
target-vehicle measured line splines, clamps, bend radii and fitting clocking
pre-May-1991 suction-pipe exact installed bend radii below the condenser
suspectedScaleErrors: No measured target-vehicle survey is available; component dimensions are reference-estimated.
uncertainties: The working target is December 1989 U.S. UCF10L with CA emissions and air suspension; VIN-level confirmation is still not supplied.
Installed refrigerant, oil, retrofit adapters and conversion workmanship cannot be determined from photographs.
Exact A/C tube bend coordinates, clamp holes, fitting clocking and under-cover access need physical measurements or scan data.
Factory evidence conflicts with the prior registry mapping for the high service port; the model places it on the high-pressure liquid route but does not claim an exact tube landing.

The early EPC establishes the A/B/C/D/E and suction B/C/E sequence; Lexus L-AC003-91 and TSB0054L establish the lower-front suction-pipe silhouette and that the oil-tank pipe begins in May 1991, but installed centerlines remain provisional until measured.
The December-1989 target predates the August-1990 EPR revision and April-1990 power-steering return-tube revision; pre-change families are modeled from L-AC002-91 and L-ST001-90.
EPR and expansion-valve hidden dimensions are approximate because no measured HVAC-case scan is available.
Full body, hood hinge, bumper reinforcement, dashboard and underbody shapes are recognizable service landmarks, not production CAD.

acceptanceWalkthrough.description: Select the compressor and identify suction and discharge connections.
Trace compressor discharge to the condenser.
Trace condenser liquid flow through the receiver-drier toward the firewall.
Trace low-side suction flow from firewall/EPR to compressor.
Show condenser relative to radiator and front bumper.
Show receiver-drier relative to passenger headlight and radiator support.
Show evaporator and expansion-valve area with cabin/firewall cutaway.
Display high/low service ports and fitting locations with uncertainty labels.
Compare a saved model pose against a real reference image.
Run validation with zero unexplained disconnected A/C lines.

referenceRights.userSuppliedPhotos: Private working references supplied by the user. Provenance/licensing is not cleared for public redistribution; do not publish or ship these images without rights confirmation.
referenceRights.charmAndEpcImages: Private factory-derived research references. Reuse rights are not cleared; exclude them from any public or shipped bundle.
referenceRights.licensedUcf10Exterior: Public-domain Australian RHD UCF10R rear three-quarter; retain provenance and do not treat it as exact U.S. 1990 underhood evidence.
